R7-B02-M2 design specification: The substantial visual center is a single urban pedestrian space split diagonally open in TWO solid volumetric sections. Behind a foreground building wall and a full leafy tree, the opening reveals a doorway threshold, continuing pedestrian floor, rear room/courtyard and another building plane. The two separated cut bodies run at generous scale from the upper right to lower left of the poster and ENCIRCLE a broad frontal editorial opening; they are not a standalone little model parked between headline and footer. The bodily gap visibly uncovers previously hidden everyday city context, reflecting gaps in observed data and why local context matters. Use one coherent oblique axonometric viewpoint, recognizable doors and connected walking floor, consistent contact shadows, clear matte planar wall surfaces and volumetric tree foliage. No top-down street map, no real Seongsu venue depiction, no diagram axes, data measurements, floating data dots, legends or factual geography.

Color and material arise from the split: pale warm light ground and calm ink-navy frontal text; terracotta exposed cut faces make the revelation clear; blue-grey/ochre building fronts and deep green trees distinguish visible surfaces. Broad clean matte planes, restrained soft directional shadows; no glossy toy finish, no gratuitous texture or ornament.
